requirements.text: Where condition (b) is applied, the integrated luminous intensity of the reversing projector tested together with the reversing lamp shall not exceed the maximum luminous intensity required in Table 10.
requirements.quote: the integrated luminous intensity shall not exceed the maximum luminous intensity required in the Table 10.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing projector shall be white.
requirements.quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be white.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with paragraph 5., no measured value of the lamp shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.quote: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with paragraph 5., for the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values of the lamp shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.quote: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3 the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12

requirements.quote: The lamp shall be installed on a vehicle only as part of a pair of lamps: yes/no2 2Strike out what does not apply.

requirements.quote: Lamp approved for LED substitute light source(s): yes/no2 If yes, category of LED substitute light source(s) .....................................

requirements.quote: Rated voltage or the range of voltage: .............................................

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV for the various directions of measurement of the rear lamp shall give the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.quote: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, when the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity of the rear position lamp shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (b) Front and rear position lamps;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, when the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity of the stop lamp shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (e) Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity of the rear lamp in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.quote: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, in the case of the reversing lamp, if visual examination of the lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit, for the various directions of measurement given in figure A3-V, at least the minimum intensities in cd shown in figure A3-V.
requirements.quote: The values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the rear lamp shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any rear lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation, for the conformity of mass-produced lamps not to be contested.
requirements.quote: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random: (a) No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on the lamp shall be repeated using another standard light source.
requirements.quote: (b) If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp using light source technology other than incandescent technology, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp and stop lamp using light source technology other than incandescent technology, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.

requirements.text: In case the lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the rear lamp function shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.

requirements.text: After the lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
requirements.quote: After the lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.

requirements.text: In case of doubt the intensity of light shall be measured according to paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt the intensity of light shall be measured according to paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: At that measurement the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.
requirements.quote: At that measurement the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.

requirements.text: The light emitting surface of the rear lamp shall be declared by the manufacturer in the request for approval on the drawing, see Annex 3.
requirements.quote: "Light emitting surface" of a "lighting device", "light-signalling device" or a retro-reflector means the surface as declared in the request for approval by the manufacturer of the device on the drawing, see Annex 3 (see e.g. Parts 1, and 4).

requirements.text: In the case where the outer lens is textured, the declared light emitting surface of the rear lamp shall be all or part of the exterior surface of the outer lens.
requirements.quote: (a) In the case where the outer lens is textured, the declared light emitting surface shall be all or part of the exterior surface of the outer lens;

requirements.text: In the case where the outer lens is non-textured, the light emitting surface of the rear lamp shall be as declared on the drawing, see Annex 3, the outer lens being disregarded.
requirements.quote: (b) In the case where the outer lens is non-textured the outer lens may be disregarded and the light emitting surface shall be as declared on the drawing, see Annex 3 (see e.g. Part 5).

requirements.text: To determine the lower, upper and lateral limits of the illuminating surface of the rear lamp, only screens with horizontal or vertical edges shall be used to verify the distance to the extreme edges of the vehicle and the height above the ground.
requirements.quote: To determine the lower, upper and lateral limits of the illuminating surface only screens with horizontal or vertical edges shall be used to verify the distance to the extreme edges of the vehicle and the height above the ground.

requirements.text: For other applications of the illuminating surface, e.g. distance between two lamps or functions, the shape of the periphery of the illuminating surface of the rear lamp shall be used.
requirements.quote: For other applications of the illuminating surface, e.g. distance between two lamps or functions, the shape of the periphery of this illuminating surface shall be used.

requirements.text: When determining the illuminating surface of the rear lamp, the screens shall remain parallel.
requirements.quote: The screens shall remain parallel, but other orientations are allowed to be used.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the rear lamp may be subjected, the rear lamp retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be so fitted that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the rear lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with for the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: For the purposes of determining the lower, upper and lateral edges of the device, only horizontal and vertical planes shall be considered.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of determining the lower, upper and lateral edges of the device, only horizontal and vertical planes shall be considered.

requirements.text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall:.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall:

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: The rear lamp may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps only if all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When all other functions with which the lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp shall fulfil its photometric and colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, and the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON, the rear lamp shall fulfil the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The stop lamp and direction-indicator lamp shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
requirements.quote: Any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis, shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour;

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
requirements.quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the lamp shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or

requirements.text: As an alternative, where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the lamp shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), is composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, the lamps or retro reflectors shall be installed in such a way that the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or

requirements.text: As an alternative, where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), is composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, the lamps or retro reflectors shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, except that a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system. However, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, the following conditions shall be met:.
requirements.quote: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, the following conditions shall be met:

requirements.text: The maximum height of the rear lamp above the ground shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: The minimum height of the rear lamp above the ground shall be measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the rear lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the rear lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of the rear lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of the rear lamp vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of the rear lamp vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red rear lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., for the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front by the rear lamp, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the white light emitted to the rear by the rear lamp, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamp and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the rear lamp shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component

requirements.text: As an alternative, if the requirement that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components

requirements.text: As an alternative, if the requirement that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: The lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp may be allowed only if the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp may be allowed only if the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., may be allowed only if the intensity of all the lamps mentioned, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, varies all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.quote: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., may be allowed only if, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, is maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.quote: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions.
requirements.quote: For vehicles of M and N categories the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions:

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear lamp, where according to its type approval documentation it has been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the rear lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the rear lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If, when the rear lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear lamp (device) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp is installed on a vehicle approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, the rear lamp shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear lamp approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) may be used exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
requirements.quote: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.

requirements.text: To verify that the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is respected, both at the type approval and in the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the rear lamp related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
requirements.quote: To verify that this statement is respected, both at the type approval and in the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be one device mandatory on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there is only one device, the geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° to right and to left.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there are two devices, the geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: When the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the reference axis of the respective reversing lamp shall be directed outwards with an angle β not exceeding 15° relative to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, whereby the geometric visibility is considered to be ensured.
requirements.quote: The geometric visibility is considered to be ensured if the reference axis of the respective device is directed outwards with an angle β not exceeding 15° relative to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Rearwards

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5 shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5 shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where an optional rear lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (b) Where an optional rear lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp of category 6 shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 30° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: 30° above and 5° below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of category 6.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1) may have the inward angle of 45° reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where, at the discretion of the manufacturer, the arrangement for M1 and N1 category vehicles is used, the direction-indicator lamp shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, at the discretion of the manufacturer, the arrangement for M1 and N1 category vehicles is used, the direction-indicator lamp shall, to be considered visible, provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, except for side direction-indicators of categories 5 and 6.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, except for side direction-indicators of categories 5 and 6.

requirements.text: Where, at the discretion of the manufacturer, the arrangement for M1 and N1 category vehicles is used, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the apparent surface of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control.
requirements.quote: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control and shall flash in phase.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall flash in phase.
requirements.quote: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control and shall flash in phase.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 vehicles less than 6 m in length, with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2. above, the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.quote: On M1 and N1 vehicles less than 6 m in length, with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2. above, the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps.

requirements.text: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
requirements.quote: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential), shall not switch between both modes once activated.

requirements.text: If two optional lamps (category 2a or 2b) are installed on vehicles in categories M2, M3, N2, N3, the optional lamps shall be operated in the same mode as the other mandatory rear direction indicator lamps (category 2a or 2b); i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.quote: If two optional lamps (category 2a or 2b) are installed on vehicles in categories M2, M3, N2, N3, they shall be operated in the same mode as the other mandatory rear direction indicator lamps (category 2a or 2b); i.e. static or sequential.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.quote: The light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.

requirements.text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light from the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.

requirements.text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one and one-half seconds by the first extinction of the light of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.

requirements.text: If a motor vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the control of the direction-indicator lamps on the drawing vehicle shall also operate the indicator lamps of the trailer.
requirements.quote: If a motor vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the control of the direction-indicator lamps on the drawing vehicle shall also operate the indicator lamps of the trailer.

requirements.text: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the other direction-indicator lamps shall continue to flash, but the frequency in this condition may be different from that prescribed.
requirements.quote: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the others shall continue to flash, but the frequency in this condition may be different from that prescribed.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be mandatory.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5. above.
requirements.quote: The signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5. above.

requirements.text: All direction indicators of the category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) activated simultaneously for the hazard warning signal shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.quote: All direction indicators of the category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) activated simultaneously shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.

requirements.text: All direction indicators of the category 2 (2a, 2b) activated simultaneously for the hazard warning signal shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.quote: All direction indicators of the category 2 (2a, 2b) activated simultaneously shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 category shall be mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comprise two S1 or S2 category devices on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comprise one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The centre of reference of the S3 or S4 category stop lamp device shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2., the stop lamp devices shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: Where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that the maximum may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be positioned at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground, except that the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.
requirements.quote: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall: either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground. However, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall provide horizontal geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices shall provide horizontal geometric visibility of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle;

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices shall provide vertical geometric visibility of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be present on the vehicle (mandatory).
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have two rear position lamps, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in width such that the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that the maximum may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional lamps shall be placed at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional lamps shall be not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
