requirements.text: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the apparent surface considered for the rear position lamp visibility.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale (mandatory).
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: Except when daytime running lamps are switched ON, the closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamp shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: If required by the component Regulation, the rear position lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The parking lamp shall be oriented such that the lamps meet the requirements for visibility forwards and rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Such that the lamps meet the requirements for visibility forwards and rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connection shall allow the parking lamp(s) on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.
requirements.quote: The connection shall allow the parking lamp(s) on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.

requirements.text: The parking lamp(s) and, if applicable, the front and rear position lamps according to paragraph 6.12.9. below, shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.quote: The parking lamp(s) and, if applicable, the front and rear position lamps according to paragraph 6.12.9. below, shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.

requirements.text: The parking lamp shall not have a device which automatically switches OFF these lamps as a function of time.
requirements.quote: A device which automatically switches OFF these lamps as a function of time is prohibited.

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall be oriented such that the lamps meet the requirements for visibility forwards and rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Such that the lamps meet the requirements for visibility forwards and rearwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be present on motor vehicles, except that, provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, it is optional on trailers.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles. Provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, optional on trailers.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: Where additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below) are fitted, they shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 900 mm above the ground, except that it may be not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), and not more than 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be of a number such that the requirements for longitudinal positioning are complied with.
requirements.quote: Number Such that the requirements for longitudinal positioning are complied with.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm, except that the maximum height may be increased to 1,200 mm if grouped with any lamp(s), and to 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively or if the presence of the device is not mandatory according to paragraph 6.17.1.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively or if the presence of the device is not mandatory according to paragraph 6.17.1.).

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be fitted so that at least one side retro-reflector is fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, except that this does not apply to M1 and N1 category vehicles.
requirements.quote: In length: at least one side retro-reflector shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side retro-reflector being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front.

requirements.text: The foremost side retro-reflector shall be not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front, except that this does not apply to M1 and N1 category vehicles.
requirements.quote: In length: at least one side retro-reflector shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side retro-reflector being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front.

requirements.text: The distance between two adjacent side retro-reflectors shall not exceed 3 m, except that this does not apply to M1 and N1 category vehicles and, if the structure, design or the operational use of the vehicle makes it impossible to comply, this distance may be increased to 4 m.
requirements.quote: The distance between two adjacent side retro-reflectors shall not exceed 3 m. This does not, however, apply to M1 and N1 category vehicles. If the structure, design or the operational use of the vehicle makes it impossible to comply with such a requirement, this distance may be increased to 4 m.

requirements.text: The distance between the rearmost side retro-reflector and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 1 m, except that for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.quote: The distance between the rearmost side retro-reflector and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 1 m. However, for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m but does not exceed 7 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted not further than 3 m from the front and one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.quote: For M1 vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m but does not exceed 7 m it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted not further than 3 m from the front and one within the last third of the vehicle length.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° to the front and to the rear.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° to the front and to the rear.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be oriented towards the side.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the side.

requirements.text: The conspicuity markings shall be considered continuous if the distance between adjacent elements is as small as possible and does not exceed 50 per cent of the shortest adjacent element length, except that if the manufacturer can prove to the satisfaction of the Type Approval Authority that it is impossible to respect the value of 50 per cent, the distance between adjacent elements may be larger than 50 per cent of the shortest adjacent element, and shall be as small as possible and not exceed 1,000 mm.
requirements.quote: Conspicuity markings shall be considered continuous if the distance between adjacent elements are as small as possible and do not exceed 50 per cent of the shortest adjacent element length. However, if the manufacturer can prove to the satisfaction of the Type Approval Authority that it is impossible to respect the value of 50 per cent, the distance between adjacent elements may be larger than 50 per cent of the shortest adjacent element, and it shall be as small as possible and not exceed 1,000 mm.

requirements.text: In the case of a partial contour marking, each upper corner of the conspicuity marking shall be described by two lines at 90° to each other and each at least 250 mm in length.
requirements.quote: In the case of a partial contour marking, each upper corner shall be described by two lines at 90°, to each other and each at least 250 mm in length; if this is not possible, the marking shall follow as close as practicable the contour of the outer shape of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of a partial contour marking, if it is not possible for each upper corner to be described by two lines at 90° to each other and each at least 250 mm in length, the conspicuity marking shall follow as close as practicable the contour of the outer shape of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In the case of a partial contour marking, each upper corner shall be described by two lines at 90°, to each other and each at least 250 mm in length; if this is not possible, the marking shall follow as close as practicable the contour of the outer shape of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The locations on the vehicle designated for conspicuity markings shall allow for the installation of markings of at least 60 mm in width.
requirements.quote: The locations on the vehicle designated for conspicuity markings shall allow for the installation of markings of at least 60 mm in width.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The conspicuity markings shall meet: The distance between the conspicuity marking fitted to the rear of a vehicle and each mandatory stop lamp should be greater than 200 mm.
requirements.quote: The distance between the conspicuity marking fitted to the rear of a vehicle and each mandatory stop lamp should be greater than 200 mm.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.

requirements.text: The position of the lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the position of the lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of the lamps shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the \u00b13\u00ba variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

requirements.quote: Reversing lamps: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply.

requirements.text: The stop-lamps: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply shall be yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply. (stop-lamps).
requirements.quote: Stop-lamps: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply.

requirements.quote: Rear position lamps: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply.

requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply.

requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflectors, triangular: yes/no2........................ 2Strike out which does not apply.

requirements.text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear of the rear lamp shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear lamp shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

requirements.text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the lamps of the rear lamp shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
requirements.quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.

requirements.text: The lamps and their markings shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The lamps and their markings shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: All markings of the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.text: All markings of the retro-reflective device shall be indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F, the retro-reflective device shall bear an orientation mark "TOP" on any marking material whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational.
requirements.quote: in case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F an orientation mark "TOP" on any marking material whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective marking plates of Class 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5, the retro-reflective device shall bear, on the plates whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational, the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the part of the plates which is intended to be the highest part of the plate when mounted on the vehicle.
requirements.quote: in case of retro-reflective marking plates of Class 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5, on the plates whose retro-reflective system is not omni-rotational, the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the part of the plates which is intended to be the highest part of the plate when mounted on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective marking material approved to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Any retro-reflective marking material approved to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The conformity of production of the retro-reflective marking material shall not be contested if the mean value of the photometric measurements of five specimens taken at random deviates unfavourably by not more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values given in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking of the retro-reflector and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.

requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: For the resistance to water penetration test, the retro-reflector, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: For the resistance to water penetration test, the immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflector through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: For the resistance to water penetration test, the retro-reflector sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflector shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflector being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflective marking plates, a section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in distilled water at a temperature of 23 ± 5ºC for a period of 18 hours.
requirements.quote: A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in distilled water at a temperature of 23 ± 5ºC for a period of 18 hours;

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflective marking plates, the section shall be left to dry for 24 hours under normal laboratory conditions after immersion.
requirements.quote: it shall then be left to dry for 24 hours under normal laboratory conditions.

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflective marking plates, after completion of the test, the section shall be examined.

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflective marking plates, after completion of the test, no part of the retro-reflective marking plate inside 10 mm from the cut edge shall show evidence of deterioration which would reduce the effectiveness of the plate.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the retro-reflective device of Class IB or IIIB shall be subjected to the moisture and dust tests.

requirements.text: The sample device, mounted on a test fixture with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in the water spray test procedure.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, during the water spray test these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.quote: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period of the water spray test, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period of the water spray test, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period of the water spray test, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

regulations.rationale: Consolidated device regulation covering the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp in this module. (lexical: term match score 14.8)
Installation regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices on M1 vehicles, which is where this lamp is fitted. (lexical: term match score 34.9)
Consolidated retro-reflective device regulation covering the integrated retro-reflector. (lexical: term match score 7.7)
The lamp contains LED modules on a PCB, an electronic sub-assembly, so EMC requirements apply. (lexical: term match score 9.3)
Legacy regulation for position and stop lamps, now consolidated into R148, which is preferred. (lexical: term match score 1.6; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Legacy reversing lamp regulation, consolidated into R148, which is preferred. (lexical: term match score 1.6; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

The LEDs are non-replaceable modules on a PCB rather than approved LED light source categories. (lexical: term match score 11.5)
External projections apply to the vehicle body; a rear lamp is not typically assessed as a separate product under this regulation. (lexical: term match score 0.2)
The lamp uses LED modules, not filament light sources. (lexical: term match score 0.5)
Covers road illumination devices (headlamps, fog lamps), not rear signalling. (lexical: term match score 9.4)
The module has no rear fog lamp. (lexical: term match score 0.8; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Braking system regulation, not the stop lamp device. (lexical: term match score 0.7)
The module contains no direction indicator, so R6 is not relevant. (lexical: term match score 0.6; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

profile.product: Rear lamp (combined rear lighting and signalling module with rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, outer lens and retro-reflector in a single housing)
functions: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility) - rear position lamp, 4 to 17 cd on axis
Braking indication - stop lamp, 60 to 185 cd on axis
Reversing illumination - reversing lamp, visible to 45° outboard
Passive conspicuity - retro-reflector, reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence
Light transmission and colour definition - outer lens, red within the chromaticity limits
Sealing against water ingress - no water ingress after the spray test
materials: Reflector surface: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
Light source: LED modules on PCB
Fasteners / clips: PA, POM, or steel
